player_prompt.intro:
Wo reko Countdown numbers game!
Botae: Fa nam kuo mu denkyem no +, -, *, / so na wo aduane.
Nhyehyɛe format: [i j op] baako i,j yɛ indices na op yɛ adwuma no.
Nhwehwɛmu: [0 2 *] kuo nam a ɛwɔ index 0 ne nam a ɛwɔ index 2.
Kɔfa mu no sɛe sɛe nkutoo na ɛbɛyɛ nam kutoo.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Nhyehyɛe format a ɛnteɛ. Fa `[i j op]` baako i,j yɛ indices na op yɛ +,-,*,/
invalid_move.invalid_indices: Ɛnsɛ sɛ ɛyɛ soronko na ɛwɔ 0-{max_index} mu.
invalid_move.invalid_operation: Adwuma a enni mu (sɛnea wobedi no so)

outcome.no_moves: Nhyehyɛe nni bio. Deɛ ɛyɛ papa: {best_value} (botae: {target})
outcome.turn_limit: Nhyehyɛe kwan duruu. Deɛ ɛyɛ papa: {best_value} (botae: {target})
